description: This file defines the BordersRenderer class responsible for rendering Borders objects to RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It includes methods to render individual borders and manages border rendering options based on context.

classes.name: BordersRenderer
classes.description: A class to render a Borders object to RTF, inheriting from BorderRendererBase, with methods to handle rendering of individual borders and borders customization.

methods.name: BordersRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing BordersRenderer with a DocumentObject and RtfDocumentRenderer, casting the document object to Borders.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the Borders object to RTF, handling each border side and optional directional borders like diagonal down and up.

methods.name: CreateBorderRenderer
methods.description: Creates a BorderRenderer instance for a specific Border and BorderType, setting parent cell and format context.
